edit.description: Try direct execFile first, retry with shell only on a win32 ENOENT, per platform-facts.md — currently sets shell:true unconditionally on win32 for both the pnpm and npm branches.
Pin the ENOENT-gated fallback: direct spawn used when it doesn't ENOENT; shell retry only fires on a win32 ENOENT and non-ENOENT errors propagate without retry.

summary: setupWorktree.ts spawns pnpm/npm with shell:true unconditionally on win32 instead of the direct-spawn-then-ENOENT-only-fallback platform-facts.md documents.

per.section: Node refuses to spawn a `.cmd` shim without a shell

tests: direct spawn is used and succeeds without going through a shell
a win32 ENOENT retries through the shell; a non-ENOENT error propagates without retry
acceptance: setupWorktree's two execFileP call sites try a direct spawn first and fall back to shell:true only on a win32 ENOENT; new tests fail on the pre-fix unconditional shell:true and pass after.
notes: Sibling precedent already in tree: src/builtinGates.ts's execGate implements exactly this fallback for the same CVE-2024-27980 shim problem. Sharing that helper instead of re-deriving a divergent version is preferred (engineering.md 'The fix lands at the mechanism') but not required if inlining the same catch shape is simpler.
